source_text: Salvator cognoscebat seipsum factum ex semine David secundum carnem, praedestinatum Filium Dei in virtute; Ego sum via, veritas et vita; ante Abraham ego sum; Verbum quod erat in principio apud Deum. Pharisaei sciebant quod secundum dispensationem humanam de semine David erat, profundiora vero nesciebant. Gloria Christo. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: The Savior was-knowing himself made from seed of David according-to flesh, predestined Son of God in power; I am way, truth and life; before Abraham I am; Word which was in beginning with God. Pharisees were-knowing that which according-to human dispensation from seed of David was, but deeper things were-not-knowing. Glory to Christ. Amen.
pass_b_english: The Savior knew himself [[made from the seed of David according to the flesh >> Bible:Romans 1:3]], predestined Son of God in power; [[I am the way and the truth and the life >> Bible:John 14:6]]; [[before Abraham I am >> Bible:John 8:58]]; the Word that was in the beginning with God. The Pharisees knew the human dispensation from David’s seed, but not the deeper things. Glory to Christ. Amen.
notes: Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
